items.question: Are students guaranteed to get successfully placed?
items.answer: Yes. We guarantee at least one successful placement minimum or your money back. Our company will only accept students we feel have a high probability of successful placement.

items.question: My student’s English level is very low. Can they come to America for study?
items.answer: Yes. Premier Academy has relationships with many schools across the country which take students at a very beginning English level. We would most likely place your student into a school with a special ELD/ESL curriculum.

items.question: Will you consult for the US visa application, including the I-20 invitation letter and F-1 Student Visa?
items.answer: Yes. Part of our service is ensuring that both the I-20 invitation letter and F-1 Student Visa are correctly issued. We also help prepare you for the US Embassy interview.

items.question: What cities in the United States do you place students to?
items.answer: We cover Los Angeles, San Francisco and New York as the main three cities. Secondary cities include Chicago, Houston, Seattle and Atlanta.

items.question: How do you select the home stay sponsor families?
items.answer: Premier Academy interviews many prospective families who want to be a sponsor family. Full background checks are performed and preference is given to those families with experience and a proven track record. Premier Academy also works directly with each school, many of which already perform their own pre-screening of families.

items.question: What is the cost of schooling vs. boarding?
items.answer: School tuition ranges from as little as $15,000 USD per year to as high as $75,000 per year for boarding schools that include housing and meals where students live on campus. Home stay students can expect to pay anywhere from $1,800 to $2,500 each month for housing and meals. All prices vary depending on the school, family and location in the United States.
